pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-rounded dark-tan regions with moderately jagged edge gradients. Individual patches show high geometric variance, with larger surface area on the mid-flank compared to the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored dividers showing high topological connectivity. Junction nodes are predominantly triradial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank region with slight narrowing at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, brown vertical filaments visible on the superior neck silhouette, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: An elongated, dark vertical textural disruption is visible on the upper right dorsal-lateral region. Multiple small, dark, raised nodules are present along the mid-dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark vertical linear mark on the right shoulder area that disrupts the local pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The tail base shows high-contrast horizontal banding within its localized patch structure.
